name: mathacademy_timeback
what: mathacademy_timeback is the meaning layer for Math Academy data as it lives inside Timeback: every Math Academy task a student completes arrives as a Caliper event and is stored in Timeback's OneRoster (assessment results, line items, enrollments, classes, courses, users) and EduBridge analytics (event facts, daily rollups). Readers use a Timeback credential only; this skill never calls Math Academy. It answers, numbered to match ENABLEMENT § Capabilities: (1) a student's Math Academy task history with type, topic, XP, accuracy and time; (2) daily and weekly totals per student; (3) the student's current Math Academy course, completion percent and its age, and an estimated XP remaining with its basis and bias named; (4) who has gone quiet in a course; (5) who has finished a course, results-first with the store's completion date as confirmation, and whether they were moved on; (6) where a student is struggling, by topic, and whether they recovered; (7) a weak Timeback-only suspect-course heuristic for when the store is stale or silent (item 10 answers the question definitively); (8) estate-wide Math Academy activity for a day or week attributed to the course each event was filed under; (9) a student's whole Math Academy timeline across seats, including events filed under deleted seats; (10) Math Academy's own figures for a student from this skill's store, refreshed nightly (the course Math Academy really runs them in, exact XP remaining, progress, grade and letter grade, estimated SAT score, account state) with a live check of whether the Timeback seat agrees; (11) Math Academy's engaged versus productive time per task and the student's nightly course history; (12) the per-topic knowledge map, fetched live once on request and cached. All store routes sit behind the reader's Timeback token; the reader never calls Math Academy.
when: Reach for mathacademy_timeback when the question is about Math Academy students and can be answered from what Timeback received: activity, progress percent, quiet students, finished students, failed tasks, a student's history across seats, and whether the Timeback course record is coherent. For Math Academy's own figures (true course, exact XP remaining, grade, SAT estimate, engaged versus productive time, course history, knowledge map) read this skill's store (how.native.store; ENABLEMENT examples 10 to 12); it refreshes nightly and every response carries snapshotAt and stale. Route away to the Math Academy API only for what is fresher than last night or never pulled (the course catalogue, a day the store did not pull); ENABLEMENT.md § One-off exact figures gives the per-student calls and the key they need, as a fallback outside this skill's wire, never a polling path. Route to timeback_production (https://timeback-loops-k8.vercel.app/dss/timeback_production/skill) or timeback_analytics (https://platform.timeback.com/mcps/analytics/skill) for the whole learning record across apps, MAP and mastery, screen-capture minutes and waste. The headline trap: the Timeback course an event is filed under is the course of the enrollment the platform matched at ingestion, often a since-deleted one and never the course Math Academy is actually running the student in; if the enrollment is wrong every event is filed under the wrong course and no field says so (DICTIONARY traps 10 and 21, ENABLEMENT examples 7, 8 and 9).

why.relevance: Math Academy is the core mathematics app for Alpha students in grades 4 to 12, and its events are the largest single external activity stream Timeback holds for math. The raw rows do not explain themselves: the task type hides in a URL, waste is always zero, reviews revisit earlier courses, titles are not canonical, and completion percent lives in three places (results, enrollments, the store). This skill supplies the genesis of every field, the named traps, and worked recipes, so a cold agent can answer without being silently wrong and without spamming the Math Academy API.
why.note: sha256 pins the exact bytes served at GET https://data-source-skills.vercel.app/contract on the day this front was built; version echoes that fetch's X-Doc-Version header. Re-pinned on every deploy.

native.auth: Bearer <token>; the reader brings its own Timeback credential. Mint the token with an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials POST (grant_type=client_credentials; client id + secret as HTTP Basic, or as form fields) to https://prod-beyond-timeback-api-2-idp.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token; tokens expire after expires_in seconds (one hour as served). This front holds no key and proxies no data.
native.keyKind: a Timeback API client (OAuth 2.0 client id + secret on the Cognito pool above) with READ-ONLY scopes covering OneRoster rostering + gradebook reads and EduBridge analytics reads (the scopes named powerpath.readonly and analytics/v1p0/readOnly were sufficient for every call in ENABLEMENT.md). No write scope is needed and none should be granted.
native.keyContact: one client per person or agent, never shared: request it from the Timeback platform team (owner of api.alpha-1edtech.ai; tracker trilogy-group/timeback-platform). This skill issues no keys.
native.denied: a 401 on the token endpoint is a bad or expired client; a 403 or an empty result on a route that works for others is a scope or org limit of YOUR key, never an absence of data.

routes.results: GET /ims/oneroster/gradebook/v1p2/assessmentResults?filter=metadata.appName='Math Academy' AND scoreDate>='<utc instant>' AND scoreDate<='<utc instant>'&sort=scoreDate&orderBy=asc   (both bounds honoured; an America/Chicago day is 05:00Z..04:59:59Z in CDT)
routes.enrollments: GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/enrollments/?filter=user.sourcedId='<sid>' AND status='active'   (or filter=class.sourcedId='<cid>' AND status='active' for a section's roster)
routes.classes: GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/classes/?filter=course.sourcedId='<courseId>'   (every section of a course; title~'Math Academy' lists all Math Academy sections)
routes.courses: GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/courses/?filter=title~'Math Academy'   and GET .../courses/{id} for metadata.metrics.totalXp

store.what: this skill's own store of Math Academy's student records (Math Academy public API beta10), matched to Timeback students. Refreshed nightly at 03:00 America/Chicago (bulk list, four pages, plus one lookup per new student); at 03:45 the per-task activity analysis (engaged / productive time) is pulled for every student who had a Math Academy result on each local day from the day before the last pulled day through yesterday (a missed night is caught up; the overlap day is re-pulled and overwrites by task id, never duplicates); every night's course figures are appended to a per-student history; the knowledge map is fetched live once on request and cached for seven days; a student missing from the store is looked up live once when first asked for. Every response carries snapshotAt and stale.
store.history: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/history  (one row per DATE since the store began on 2026-09-17; course changes and, where Math Academy set it before the move, the old course's completion date; carries snapshotAt, stale, storeBegan)
store.activity: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/activity?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD  (America/Chicago days; Math Academy's per-task timeElapsedMs / timeEngagedMs / timeProductiveMs, type, xp (nominal) and xpAwarded (= Timeback metadata.xp), course, topic, taskId; day totals in milliseconds with windowUtc; carries snapshotAt, stale, storeBegan, activityLastDate, reasonIfEmpty; Timeback's own activeSeconds is the ENGAGED clock)
store.knowledge: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/knowledge[?courseId=&refresh=1]  (one live Math Academy call on first ask, cached 7 days per courseId; response knowledge.courses[] has prerequisites FIRST and the requested course last, use knowledge.requestedCourse; stability 0 = no current evidence, untaught OR just failed; never loop it over a roster)
store.status: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store  (snapshotAt, rosterReadAt, snapshotAgeHours, staleAfterDays, stale, schedule {nextSnapshotDueUtc, firstScheduledRunHasHappened, scheduledRunsSoFar}, history[] {at, source: schedule | schedule-test | manual}, activityLastDate, lastActivityRun, health, snapshotCalls, readCalls (estate-wide), routes, notes open to anyone; counts (with a nonTest block) and byCourse (each with a nonTest block) only when the request carries the reader's Timeback token, else countsGated true; no student values)
store.range: every student with a current in-window Math Academy seat at rosterReadAt, plus students added by a live lookup (a reader's first read, or the activity pull meeting a student with results but no id); students progression has moved out of Math Academy or left seatless are 'not in snapshot' until read once, so most FINISHED students are absent until asked for (ENABLEMENT ex. 5)
store.mathAcademyCourses: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/courses  (Math Academy course id -> name; the vocabulary of mathAcademyCourseId and currentCourse.id)
store.course: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/course/{course.sourcedId}  (one Timeback course's roster at snapshot time counted by courseAgreement, testUsers, maNotStarted; no credential)
store.student: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}[?minimal=1]  or  GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student?email=<email>  (about one second each; two Timeback calls replayed; minimal=1 drops username, names, league and schedule)
store.freshness: the store began 2026-09-17 with manual loads; the scheduler was proven the same day (history source schedule-test) and runs nightly from 2026-09-18; every response carries snapshotAt and stale (true past staleAfterDays, 2 as served, so a missed night shows the next day); per-student rows add figuresAsOf + figuresBasis; GET /store lists history (every load, with source), schedule (next due, whether the cron has fired) and lastActivityRun; a day can hold more than one snapshot, so pin each figure to the snapshotAt on its own response; past stale, quote Math Academy figures only with their date and take progress from Timeback's newest result (ENABLEMENT ex. 3); a stuck refresh is a ticket on the feedback wire
store.key: the Math Academy key is read at run time from one Secrets Manager secret by the nightly function and by the front (for the knowledge map and live lookups on a miss); it is never on the wire and readers never hold it
store.gate: Authorization: Bearer <the reader's own Timeback token>. Student routes replay it against Timeback (GET users/{sourcedId}, GET enrollments) and serve the row only if Timeback answers 200 for that student under that token; a reader sees exactly the students its Timeback key can read. Counts (per course, and on /store) need a token Timeback accepts. Open without a token: the documents, /store freshness/schedule/health, /store/courses. The reader never holds a Math Academy key.
store.mathAcademyCallsAtReadTime: a per-student read makes no Math Academy call UNLESS the student is missing from the store (then one live lookup, once per 24 h per student); the knowledge route makes one live call per student per courseId per 7 days; nothing else reaches Math Academy at read time. GET /store counts both under readCalls. Never loop the per-student route over a roster to find unmatched students: use /store/course/{id}/students?agreement=no math academy record.
store.courseStudents: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/course/{course.sourcedId}/students[?agreement=<value>]  (the reader's token; response {courseSourcedId, snapshotAt, stale, filter, count, nonTestCount, students (= count), rows[]}; each row {sourcedId, courseAgreementAtSnapshot, matchedBy, matchConfidence, isTestUser, mathAcademyState, mathAcademyCourseId, mathAcademyCourseName, progress, xpRemaining, completed, startDate, estimatedScore, deactivated, figuresAsOf}; no names; an unknown agreement value is a 400 with the allowed list)
store.courseActivity: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/course/{course.sourcedId}/activity?date=YYYY-MM-DD  (the reader's token; every roster student's day totals for one pulled America/Chicago day, milliseconds; the cohort form of ENABLEMENT ex. 11)
store.fields: mathAcademy {id, username, firstName, lastName, created, deactivated, currentCourse {id, name, startDate, progress, xpRemaining, completed, grade, letterGrade, estimatedScore}, schedule, league} copied as Math Academy serves it (SAT Math Prep: progress null, estimatedScore set, xpRemaining still exact); matchedBy (known | live-lookup | activity-lookup | username | email | lookup | name) + matchConfidence; figuresAsOf (ISO) + figuresBasis; mathAcademyState (not started | in progress | at 100, not marked complete | completed); timeback.currentMathAcademySeats (live; flat seats {enrollmentSourcedId, courseSourcedId, courseName, classSourcedId, beginDate, endDate, pctCompleteApp}); courseAgreement (agree | agree, math academy course completed | disagree | disagree, math academy course completed | no current timeback seat | math academy has no current course | no math academy record | not in snapshot), a normalised name comparison plus Math Academy's completed flag, nothing more; DICTIONARY § The Math Academy snapshot store

how.explainer: https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/about  (a plain-words page for people: what the skill is, the nightly cycle, who can read what, live freshness; carries no student data)

courses.purpose: the domain of the course field: every OneRoster course titled Math Academy, with ids; a dated snapshot (readAt inside), regenerate with the call it names

courseXpSize.purpose: the XP-remaining rule list; reads the course's totalXp live, carries no figure

topicCourseMap.purpose: topic id -> majority filed course id, a dated heuristic snapshot for ENABLEMENT example 7; regenerate rather than trust

DICTIONARY.md.purpose: DICTIONARY.md carries what the OpenAPI cannot: how each Math Academy field inside Timeback is born, what its values mean, the containers and their range, the invariants and their standing, and the numbered traps. Open it before trusting any field.

ENABLEMENT.md.purpose: ENABLEMENT.md puts the source to work: twelve capabilities, a question-to-call catalog, and twelve worked examples with exact routes, output shapes and failure modes. Open it when you need to act.

documents.note: sha256 + gitVersion pin the exact bytes served at each url on this deploy; the .md routes echo them as X-Doc-SHA256 / X-Doc-Version headers.

personBearingFields: assessmentResults metadata.studentEmail (other apps' rows in a student-filtered read)
pii.readRule: a reader may read and join on these inside its own session to answer the question it was asked; several arrive unasked (DICTIONARY trap 24: enrollment rows carry user.name, the class students route returns full user records, weekly facts rows carry email, other apps' results carry metadata.studentEmail), so scrub cached responses of those fields, or use ?minimal=1 on the store
pii.publishRule: nothing that leaves the reader's session (report, dashboard, ticket, message, a file another process reads) carries a child's name, email, SIS number or login, or a row that identifies one child on its face; publish counts, classes, course ids, aggregates, or opaque user.sourcedId values to a recipient entitled to resolve them (a guide, a dashboard behind the school's login), never as a public artifact
pii.documents: every worked example in ENABLEMENT.md keys its output on user.sourcedId; DICTIONARY.md § Students are children states the rule and marks the fields
pii.servedValues: no served document or reference file of this skill contains any student value; the store routes serve one student's record only behind that reader's Timeback token, and /store serves counts only

feedback.covers: This lane covers this skill's two documents, its front, its reference files, and its store (a wrong match, a missed night, a missing student, a day of activity not pulled, a knowledge map that will not load). A defect in Timeback's APIs or data belongs to the Timeback platform (trilogy-group/timeback-platform); a defect in Math Academy's own product belongs to Math Academy. This wire does not relay third-party claims to either.
feedback.report: POST https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback with JSON {title, body, reporter, kind?} -> 201 {number, url}; no credential required
feedback.resolved: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback?state=closed  (or https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback/{number} for one ticket with its thread)
feedback.tracker: this skill's own tracker, served at GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback/{number}; every ticket is mirrored daily into a GitHub issue on trilogy-group/mathacademy-timeback-skill (labels skill-feedback + mathacademy_timeback) and closures on GitHub are copied back
feedback.note: Files an attributed ticket on the skill's own tracker and returns its number and URL at once; the ticket gains a githubUrl once the daily mirror runs. reporter is a free-text attribution and is required. kind is optional ('ask' | 'report'). Evidence in a ticket is a class, a field, a rule or a query; never a student's name, contact or identifying row.

provider.genesis: Written by an agent against the live Timeback wire on 2026-09-16, cross-checked against the Math Academy API during the build (one student's feed, the population's completion percent, task types on three students, XP remaining on ten), then corrected from the estate's registration panel and five independent cold runs on 2026-09-17; kept true by reader feedback.
